summary: Iteration 4 focused testing on (1) new GET /api/activity unified timeline endpoint, (2) Activity History frontend page at /dashboard/history, (3) official RetOps PNG logo lockup with navy-tile + mix-blend-mode lighten, plus a regression sweep of all prior-iteration endpoints. Backend: added 3 new pytest cases (TestActivity: auth guard, unified timeline shape + kinds + desc sort + >=15 events, share-event surfacing). All 29 tests PASS (was 26) against the public backend URL. Frontend: drove Playwright with seeded session cookie to /dashboard/history. Verified: sidebar 'Activity History' nav item is present between Churn Save Playbook and Settings, page subtitle shows '20 events · complete audit trail…', all six filter pills (All / Interactions scored / Churn risk / AI quality / Coaching / Shared playbooks) are clickable and correctly narrow the timeline — e.g., Churn filter = 1 shown, Shared playbooks filter = 2 shown (NovaTech + Acme). Events render with correct kind pills, HIGH RISK red label on high-severity events (2 visible), $ARR values on churn ($14,400 for Acme), +$/mo on upsell, score/100 on interaction kind. Day grouping works (Today: 11 events, Yesterday: 9 events). Clicking an interaction event navigates to /dashboard/interactions/<id>. Official RetOps PNG logo renders inside a 190x74 navy tile in the dashboard sidebar with 'Retops' text, gold shield-O, and 'REVENUE PROTECTION PLATFORM' tagline all readable (mix-blend-mode: lighten correctly converts the black PNG padding to navy).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~735 lines (crossed the 700-line split threshold flagged in iteration 3). Plan to extract routers (auth, interactions, executive, activity, playbook_share) into separate modules before the file grows further.

GET /api/activity loads up to 500 interactions + 100 shares then sorts in Python. Fine at demo scale but will grow O(n) per request. Consider MongoDB aggregation/unionWith or paginated kind-specific queries before production.

Activity sub-events (churn/ai/qa/upsell/coaching) are derived on every /api/activity call from interaction.analysis — if rubric fields are renamed in llm_service, the feed will silently drop those events. Add a unit test that an interaction with all analysis flags set yields exactly 6 events (base + 5 sub-events).
ActivityHistory.jsx does no loading state / error handling on the /activity fetch — an API failure leaves the page blank without feedback. Add a loading skeleton and an error toast.

ActivityHistory event cards lack keyboard accessibility — they are div onClick, not <button> / role='button' with Enter/Space handlers. Screen-reader and keyboard users cannot navigate into interaction detail from the feed.
